latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Orchestrates end-to-end GEO content publishing and distribution.

- Coordinates GEO content optimization, multi-channel distribution, and AI search visibility workflows.
- Summarizes publishing goals, content readiness, and provides actionable output for each workflow step.
- Generates channel-specific content variants and structured assets for website, blog, social, and more.
- Integrates (when available) with specialized GEO skills (optimizers, schema gen, etc.), else explains steps and outputs directly.
- Focuses on workflow design, campaign planning, and maximizing AI model discoverability.
